props.label: Our Story
props.heading: Built by car people, for car people
props.body:
Octane Auto Studio opened its doors in 2018 with a simple idea: give Mumbai car owners a place where their vehicles are treated with the same care and attention we would give our own.

We are not a franchise and we are not a chain. We are an independent garage founded by two automotive engineers who were tired of seeing cars leave workshops with half-done jobs and unexplained bills.

Every technician at Octane is certified, every job comes with a transparent estimate before work begins, and every car we touch gets a 30-day service warranty. We specialise in modern vehicles — Japanese, Korean, German and Indian — and invest continuously in diagnostic equipment and training.

We do not upsell. We do not fix what is not broken. And we never, ever recommend a service you do not need. That philosophy has earned us a 4.9-star rating and customers who have been with us since the day we opened.

pillars.title: Certified Technicians
pillars.text: Every technician holds ASE or equivalent certification. We hire for skill and honesty, not speed.

pillars.title: 30-Day Service Warranty
pillars.text: Every job — from an oil change to an engine rebuild — comes with a 30-day parts and labour warranty.

pillars.title: Transparent Pricing
pillars.text: You get an itemised estimate before any work begins. No surprises, no hidden fees, no upselling.

pillars.title: On-Time Delivery
pillars.text: We respect your time. If we say it will be ready by 5 PM, it is ready by 5 PM — or we tell you before the deadline.

props.label: Service Packages
props.heading: Pick a plan that fits your car
props.sub: All packages include a free health check report, itemised invoice and 30-day service warranty. Prices vary by vehicle type — select yours at checkout.

items.title: Express Service
items.desc: Perfect for a quick health check and basic maintenance. Includes oil change, filter replacement, fluid top-up, tyre pressure check and a 15-point inspection report.
items.body:
The Express Service is our most popular entry-level package — ideal if your car is due for routine maintenance or you are preparing for a long drive.

What is included:
• Engine oil change (semi-synthetic 5W30)
• Oil filter replacement
• Air filter inspection and cleaning
• Cabin filter inspection
• All fluid levels topped up (coolant, brake, washer, power steering)
• Tyre pressure check and adjustment (including spare)
• Battery voltage test
• Brake pad thickness measurement
• Light and indicator function check
• 15-point health inspection report
• Basic wash and wipe-down

Delivery: Same day — drop off by 10 AM, ready by 5 PM. Or wait in our lounge (Wi-Fi and coffee on us).

This package suits hatchbacks and sedans. For SUVs and premium vehicles, please see our Complete Detail package which includes synthetic oil and additional checks.

items.title: Complete Detail
items.desc: Comprehensive interior and exterior detailing. Includes clay bar treatment, machine polishing, ceramic wax, interior deep clean, leather conditioning and engine bay cleaning.
items.body:
The Complete Detail package is designed for car owners who want their vehicle to look and feel like it just rolled off the showroom floor. Our detailers spend 6–8 hours on each car.

What is included:
• Snow foam pre-wash and contactless rinse
• Clay bar treatment to remove bonded contaminants
• One-stage machine polish to remove swirl marks and light scratches
• Ceramic-infused wax sealant (3-month durability)
• Interior vacuum — seats, carpets, boot and headliner
• Dashboard, door cards and centre console wiped down and dressed
• Leather seats cleaned and conditioned
• Glass cleaning inside and out
• Tyres and trim dressed for a like-new finish
• Engine bay degrease and dressing
• Door jambs cleaned and waxed
• Final inspection under LED lighting

Delivery: Full day. Drop off by 9 AM, ready by 6 PM. We will send progress photos via WhatsApp during the process.

The Complete Detail is best for cars that have not been professionally detailed in the last 6 months or are being prepared for sale, a road trip or a special occasion.

items.title: Ceramic Coating
items.desc: Professional nano-ceramic coating with 5-year durability. Includes paint correction, full decontamination, two-stage machine polish and Gtechniq Crystal Serum Ultra application.
items.body:
Our Ceramic Coating package uses Gtechniq Crystal Serum Ultra — one of the most durable consumer-grade ceramic coatings available. When properly maintained, it protects your paint for up to 5 years.

The coating creates a semi-permanent bond with your car's clear coat, forming a hydrophobic layer that repels water, dirt and UV rays. Washing becomes easier, swirl marks are reduced, and the gloss deepens noticeably.

What is included:
• Full decontamination wash (snow foam, iron remover, clay bar)
• Paint thickness measurement and condition assessment
• Two-stage machine polish (cut + finish) for maximum gloss
• Panel-by-panel IPA wipe-down to remove polishing oils
• Gtechniq Crystal Serum Ultra application (two coats)
• Gtechniq EXO v3 top coat for additional hydrophobicity
• Glass coating (all exterior glass)
• Wheel faces coated for brake dust resistance
• 7-day cure instructions and maintenance guide
• 5-year warranty certificate (transferable with ownership)

Delivery: 3–4 days. The car must be left with us for the full duration as the coating requires controlled curing conditions.

Best suited for new cars or cars in excellent paint condition. We recommend this package for cars that are driven daily and parked outdoors, as the coating provides meaningful protection against environmental fallout.

items.q: How do I book a service appointment?
items.a: You can book through the contact form on this website, WhatsApp us directly at +91 98765 43210, or call us during business hours. We recommend booking at least 2–3 days in advance for regular services and 1–2 weeks ahead for ceramic coating and major repairs.

items.q: How long does a typical service take?
items.a: An Express Service takes 4–6 hours (same day). Complete Detail takes a full day (6–8 hours). Ceramic coating requires 3–4 days. Major repairs and engine work vary — we will give you a timeline after inspection. We always communicate delays before the promised deadline, never after.

We recommend genuine OEM parts for most repairs, especially for Japanese, Korean and German cars. We also stock high-quality aftermarket alternatives for parts where the OEM premium is not justified — we always present both options with pricing so you can decide.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit/debit cards and bank transfers. For major jobs (above ₹25,000), we require a 50% advance and the balance on delivery. Fleet customers can set up monthly invoicing.

items.q: Do you offer pick-up and drop service?
items.a: Yes — within a 5 km radius of our Andheri West workshop. Pick-up and drop is available for Express Service and Complete Detail packages. Additional charges may apply for locations outside the radius. We use a trained driver and insured transport.

items.q: What is your warranty on service work?
items.a: Every job we do — from an oil change to an engine rebuild — comes with a 30-day parts and labour warranty. The Gtechniq ceramic coating comes with the manufacturer's 5-year warranty (transferable with vehicle ownership). Warranty does not cover damage caused by accidents, improper maintenance by others, or unauthorised modifications.
